item.content:encoded:
I gotta say, I just wasn't terribly impressed. I've really liked what I've seen of DNM up to this point in time, but this just seemed sort of like forced concept-association of various parts of the series, which I've already read and liked. It's like if i wanted to see Watchmen and ended up watching the Saturday Morning Cartoon Watchmen video on repeat instead; I might have been amused in a different context, but this is just pretty removed from the thing I wanted to see in this spot.

Sorry, though. I know how nerve-wracking it can be doing song lyrics for the wiki.

item.content:encoded:
I am seriously contemplating singing this for you, if you'd like. Keep in mind I'm far from a Carrie Underwood, and my Turtle Beach headset is far from a recording studio, but I can imagine a little country tune in my head and I might just do it for the lulz. If you want.

Edit:

It's done.

WAIT! Not so fast! Read my disclaimers!

1. I can't sing well. I'm certainly not the worst, but I'm not good. This is for the lulz.
2. It's not perfect. I just hurried through. The timing is a little off, everything is a little off. In my opinion, it really needs background music, but I can't play anything except video games.
3. Made in Adobe Audition with my mediocre audio editing skills.
4. I'm nervous. I guess I shouldn't be. You guys don't care if my voice sucks.

Click here for 2COUNTRY4U-bet-you-didn't-know-I-actually-have-a-southern-accent madness. Remember the disclaimers.
